bottomPanel.installer_icons_generated: ✓ Placeholder icons generated in src-tauri/icons/. To swap for your game art later, run `yarn tauri icon path/to/icon.png`.
bottomPanel.installer_next_steps:
Next steps:
  1. Wait for `yarn install` to finish (running now).
  2. (If not done yet) install Rust + MSVC Build Tools (once per machine):
     - Rust:  https://rustup.rs/
     - MSVC:  https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/visual-cpp-build-tools/
     See "Generate game installer" in the IDE README for details.
  3. Click Menu → Project → Generate installer... again — this time it'll build.
